_description: Global fixes index. Each fix maps to its owning spec via spec_id. Fixes not tied to a spec have spec_id: null and live in sdd/fixes.md. Spec-scoped fixes live in sdd/specs/{spec-id}/fixes.md. Maintained by: sdd-orchestrator.
_convention: Fix ID format: FIX-[gh-user]-[spec-NNN]-[seq] for spec-scoped fixes. FIX-[gh-user]-[seq] for repo-level fixes.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: Run pnpm sdd:validate in CI
fixes.description: CI never runs pnpm sdd:validate although the kit makes it a mandatory gate for every commit. Add a dedicated job to .github/workflows/ci.yml.
fixes.justification: Single workflow file, no contract or entity change; the gate must be active as soon as the kit is installed in this repo.
fixes.test_reference: Validated locally with pnpm sdd:validate; the new CI job runs the same command.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: SDD Studio: add bypassPermissions (auto) permission mode
fixes.description: Studio only offers default/acceptEdits/plan, so every Bash/MCP call and every SPEC GATE warn asks for approval. Add bypassPermissions to the protocol enum, pass allowDangerouslySkipPermissions to the SDK and let gate warns through in that mode (gate denies still apply).
fixes.justification: Additive enum value plus a few lines in bridge and composer; no new entities. Blocks day-to-day use of the Studio.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: workspace.snapshot rescans before answering so a reload recovers missed fs events
fixes.description: FSEvents (chokidar on macOS) does not guarantee delivery under load; workspace.snapshot returned the watcher's in-memory snapshot, so a skill created in .claude/skills could stay invisible even after reloading the web. The router now awaits watcher.refresh() before answering; watcher tests stage files atomically and the .claude test retries twice.
fixes.justification: Found during cycle-02 verification on the same subproject; one router line plus tests, no contract or entity change. Blocked CA-005.5 in real use.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: Fix undefined filter error in Studio and add drawn SVG agent faces with roles
fixes.description: StudioHeader and Mission Control components read reactive state from useBridge instead of useStudio, causing TypeError on presence.filter. Also replaced plain text avatar initials with drawn SVG character faces and added role subtitles below names.
fixes.justification: Fixes runtime crash in Studio Mission Control view and addresses agent visual identification requirements.
